title: Umphefumulo Wokuqala Owama
intro: Kudala ngaphambi kokuba kuhambe noma yisiphi isithunywa emhlabeni, ngaphambi kokuba kwembulwe noma yimuphi umbhalo, kwaba khona isidalwa esingafani nanoma yisiphi esinye. Lo mphefumulo wabunjwa ngezandla zaphezulu, wanikezwa indawo yobuhle obungenakuqhathaniswa, futhi wavivinywa ngendlela eyayizozwakala kuwo wonke umlando wesintu. Okwalandela kwaba indaba yobuthakathaka, ukuphenduka okuqotho, kanye nesiphetho esasizoshintsha inkambo yendalo kuze kube phakade. Ungaqagela ukuthi ubani lo?
clues: Ngabunjwa ngezandla zoMuntu Onomusa kakhulu ngothuli lomhlabathi
Nganikwa ikhaya elihle elingenakuqhathaniswa, lapho kungekho khona indlala noma ukukhathala okwakungangithinta
Ngayalwa ukuba ngingasondeli ngisho nasemthini owodwa, ngoba wawungavunyelwe
Mina nomngane wami sakhohliswa futhi sasondela emthini owenqatshelwe, ngokumelene nomyalo weNkosi yethu
Sabuyela eNkosini yethu ngokuphenduka okuqotho, futhi sathethelelwa iziphambeko zethu
Kusuka kithi, sonke isintu sehla; ngingowokuqala ukuhamba kulo mhlaba
arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
